title: Google shakes up AI leadership as DeepMind chief Hassabis moves to chairman; Jeff Dean departs
summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced major AI leadership overhaul on Aug 5: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis moves to chairman role; 27-year veteran and chief scientist Jeff Dean exits to launch AI startup Discovery Loop. GOOGL shares fell ~4-5%, briefly erasing ~$190B in market cap. Background: Gemini flagship model has missed its June launch date, sparking concerns Google is falling behind OpenAI and Anthropic.
why: Google AI核心人才大规模流失，市场对其AI竞争力的担忧明显升温；GOOGL单日蒸发约1900亿美元市值，持有GOOGL期权者需关注隐含波动率上升及短期下行风险。

title: Fed Governor Cook: 'Prepared to raise rates if inflation doesn't cool'; warns risk of entrenched inflation
summary: Fed Governor Lisa Cook, speaking in Anchorage on Aug 5, said she is 'prepared to act by raising rates, if necessary,' warning that five years of above-target inflation risk entrenching inflation expectations. The FOMC held rates at 3.50%-3.75% at its July 29 meeting with 3 members voting to hike. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's median projection also points to one rate hike in 2026.
why: 美联储鹰派信号明确，加息预期升温将压制高估值成长股（港股科技/A股半导体）；sell put策略需关注行权价附近Delta风险；利率敏感型资产面临调整压力。

title: Strait of Hormuz: US-Iran deal talks continue; Brent swings between $80-$83 on conflicting signals
summary: Oil prices have been whipsawing as diplomatic efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz proceed. Trump paused a planned military strike following Gulf state appeals; new talks announced. However, tanker attacks continue and the Strait remains largely closed. Brent crude has swung from ~$80 on deal optimism to ~$83 on Houthi attack claims. The Strait carries ~27% of global seaborne crude trade. Asia markets Thursday watching for fresh deal signals.
why: 延续报道：霍尔木兹海峡自3月4日关闭以来持续是全球最大宏观风险，谈判进展直接牵动油价与全球通胀预期，影响中国进口原油成本；本周谈判仍处关键节点，事件高度发酵中，油价每日剧烈波动。

title: AMD Q2 CY2026: Revenue $11.54B (+50% YoY) beat — but stock slumped ~9% on gross margin miss
summary: AMD reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.54B (+50.1% YoY), non-GAAP EPS of $1.66, both beating consensus. Q3 guidance midpoint of $13B (2.9% above estimates). Despite the beat, shares fell ~8-9%: gross margin came in at 54% vs the 56% consensus, weighed down by Helios AI infrastructure ramp-up costs. Market had priced in perfection.
why: AMD毛利率未达预期引发芯片板块情绪承压；AI基建投入拖累盈利质量是本轮财报期新变量，对持有AMD或同类半导体标的期权者需注意短期负面溢出效应。

title: US stocks score new record highs on Aug 5 led by Palantir surge; HSI +0.24% on Aug 6
summary: US equity markets scored new all-time highs on Wednesday Aug 5, driven by Palantir (+30%) and broader tech. Hang Seng Index closed Aug 6 at 25,915 (+0.24%), holding gains as Asia digested US earnings. S&P 500 rising ~0.6% to fresh high. Oil nudged ~1% higher on renewed Houthi attack claims in the Red Sea.
why: 美股屡创新高提振市场情绪，港股跟随温和上涨；但美股估值偏高叠加Fed加息信号，需警惕回调风险；持有covered call的投资者或面临被动行权压力。

title: A股放量反攻：创业板指涨5.64%，半导体芯片板块强势领涨，科创50涨4.09%
summary: 2026年8月4日A股市场全天震荡走高。上证指数收报3822.28点（+0.33%）；深证成指涨3.25%；创业板指涨5.64%；科创50指数涨4.09%。半导体、AI相关个股领涨，有AI概念股8个交易日翻倍。7月新增股民266万人，市场活跃度持续提升。
why: A股半导体与AI板块强势反弹，联动海外SK海力士、美光等存储标的估值逻辑；创业板指单日涨幅显著，市场情绪乐观，但需警惕短期过热。

title: Palantir Q2 2026: Revenue +93% YoY to $1.94B, US commercial +149%; stock surged 30% on Aug 5
summary: Palantir reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.94B (+92.8% YoY), EPS of $0.41 (beat $0.34 estimate). U.S. commercial revenue jumped 149% to $764M; U.S. government revenue +90% to $809M. Full-year guidance raised to $8.15-8.16B. Stock surged ~30% on Aug 5 after earnings, but pulled back from the $166 resistance level. Company valuation ~$390B (~48x projected revenue).
why: 延续报道：财报发布（8月3日）后，PLTR于8月5日单日暴涨30%；极高估值（约48x年收入）叠加技术阻力引发回调；持仓者关注锁仓成本与隐含波动率高位；政府AI合同收入是核心驱动。

title: 段永平持仓从7.65%降至5.55%，泡泡玛特澄清：不是主动减持，系期权行权交割
summary: 港交所披露，段永平旗下H&H International Investment对泡泡玛特持仓于2026年7月30日由7.65%降至5.55%。泡泡玛特公司随即澄清：该变动并非主动减持，而是段永平此前售出的看涨期权（call options）在相应价位行权后的股份交割行为，属正常期权合约履行。值得注意的是，段永平7月23日刚在雪球表示"刚开始买泡泡玛特，大概率10年不卖"。
why: 港交所持仓披露引发市场短期情绪波动，但公司澄清系期权行权（非主动看空），事件本质为covered call策略的股份交割；从期权角度看，若行权价附近股价承压，是评估新一轮sell put的观察机会。
source: 新浪财经 / 21世纪经济报道

title: Circle (CRCL) Q2: USDC at $73.3B (+19% YoY), wins federal bank charter; Morgan Stanley slashes target to $38 from $106
summary: Circle reported Q2 2026 results (Aug 5): USDC in circulation $73.3B (+19% YoY); USDC onchain transaction volume $14.8T (+151% YoY). Key milestone: received U.S. OCC approval to establish Circle National Trust, becoming the first stablecoin issuer with a federal bank charter. Morgan Stanley downgraded CRCL to underweight and cut target from $106 to $38, citing weaker long-term earnings outlook. Circle raised "other revenue" guidance to $310-330M (from $150-170M).
why: 摩根士丹利大幅下调目标价（-64%）令CRCL短期承压；但联邦信托银行牌照是历史性里程碑，长期利好稳定币赛道监管合规化；GENIUS Act稳定币法案推进期间波动放大，期权隐含波动率高企。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) Q4 FY2026: Revenue $8.97B (beat $8.42B), gross margin 84.6%, authorized $14B buyback
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) reported Q4 FY2026 results (Aug 5): revenue $8.97B vs $8.42B estimate; non-GAAP EPS $39.25 vs $34.59 estimate (beat ~13%). Gross margin reached a record 84.6%; operating cash flow $7.1B (+135% QoQ). Board authorized additional $14B share buyback. Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint ~$10.55B. Growth driven by Datacenter and Edge segments.
why: NAND存储超级周期强劲兑现，闪迪创纪录毛利率与140亿美元回购印证存储行业盈利能力；此数据亦支撑A股存储/半导体板块估值逻辑，及SK海力士等HBM相关标的情绪；高回购有助股价支撑。
